holm_multiple_comparison.planned_family_definition: Within each (estimator mode, null-control type), correct across all eligible model-dataset pairs; the corrected claim would need significance against both matched controls.

answer.interpretation: No survival evidence exists because the requested real-model comparison could not be instantiated.
